# SD block-write timing — Session 0

Source: `Session 0.sal`, SHA-256 `2dfa9ccb1f2e0baea4d204c01366e1e75bf3d3a5d6aab9cf506d08f6fe73b057`. This is an offline decode of the user-supplied recording; no hardware commands were issued.

[Command/response transcript](TRANSCRIPT.md) · [Exact timing JSON](block-writes.json) · [Decoder evidence](decode-summary.json)

## Timing conventions

- Logic display timestamps are retained; zero is the saved capture trigger, not asserted power-on or reset.
- Data and token start/end are sampled protocol markers at rising CLK plus 16 ns. Their duration is first-to-last sampled bit, not a full inclusive wire occupancy interval. Raw DAT0 busy timing has no sampling-offset shift.
- Next-data delta is start-to-start between adjacent write packets. Last block has no next packet and uses null.
- A missing busy interval is represented by busy_observed=false and null timing, never fabricated as zero. All 3730 blocks in this recording have observed busy.
- Intervals on CMD and DAT can overlap; do not blindly sum their durations. The final CMD12 busy overlaps its R1b response and a CMD13 status exchange. Packet-train residual is only the remainder between recorded markers, not a CPU-time or internal-programming measurement.
- DAT0 busy measures card-visible backpressure. The card may internally buffer/program data outside these intervals, including during later bus transfers. This capture does not measure internal NAND program time or prove durable media persistence.
- No image bytes, image previews or payload-derived CRC values are included in this public appendix.

## Summary

One CMD25 carries **3,730 × 512-byte blocks = 1,909,760 bytes**, LBA 138,010 through 141,739. Every packet passes all four lane CRCs and every write-response token is `010` (accepted). All 3,730 per-block busy intervals are visible.

Per-block raw busy: median **0.564 µs**, minimum 0.560 µs, maximum 7459.114 µs. Data start-to-next-data start: median **85.526 µs**, minimum 85.310 µs, maximum 7544.156 µs.

Final CMD12 busy is **0.606968090 → 0.607879554 s** in Logic. It begins before the R1b response and overlaps a CMD13 response reporting programming/not-ready. First later TRAN/ready response ends at **0.608086014 s**; the last confirmation ends at **0.608185772 s**.
